dataSource: Metro Nashville-Davidson County Building Permits (ArcGIS open data), queried live
notes: Pulled live from Metro Nashville's ArcGIS open data feed on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the county has published as of your search.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
Some permit fields (status, permit number) are not published in a consistently labeled way in this dataset and may appear blank.
summary: Nashville is covered by a live query against Metro Nashville's public building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
